methodology.rawProcessModel: fresh witness process plus fresh native process per ZK raw run; fresh Node worker per control raw run
methodology.runRule: first two; 3 total unless any principal witness/native stage differs by >15% relative to their mean, then 7
methodology.execution: strictly serialized round robin in one pinned offline ARM64 container and one fixed cpuset/memory envelope
methodology.sdkHost: adaptive 3/7 fresh workers x 1000 operations after 100 warmups; fake witness/proof boundaries, reported separately
methodology.timing: all lifecycle totals are sums of independently timed components, not end-to-end latency; standard controls and SDK host record wall-clock and process CPU

aggregationRecovery.reason: The original deterministic aggregation rejected equal provenance objects whose keys had different insertion order; deep structural equality fixes reporting only.
